sections.apk:
The original project now provides apps. Open pokebonk.com ↗ (external website, opens in a new tab) and use Apps to inspect the current platform list and download destination. Current client text lists Windows, macOS, Linux and Android; v0.8.90 announces Android and Mac downloads. Our October browser-only distribution reference is historical.

  1. Choose the original project’s Apps route or its browser route.
  2. Check the exact publisher, release and destination before installing a separately maintained package.
  3. For iPhone, use the browser route unless the original menu explicitly provides another supported route. The Android listing does not establish an iOS-native app.
  4. Keep the browser session that holds your progress while checking account access in another client.

We inspected entry and release menus and public client text. No installer, offline support or account transfer was tested. A third-party offline port can use local progression, so its import/export instructions must be checked separately.

mobile.heading: If you can jump but cannot move, or menus will not scroll
mobile.addition:
First check the version. The v0.9.10 notes repair a v0.9.9 phone/tablet joystick regression that allowed jumping but prevented movement. Version 0.9.12 repairs touch scrolling in menus; v0.9.11 updates Android menu sizing. Read the current input settings after updating.

For iPhone/Safari zone-change crashes, v0.9.14 reports changes to memory handling and return-from-app behavior. These are developer-reported corrections, not a tested device guarantee. If the issue remains, report device, browser/app, game version and the exact transition.

beginners-guide.heading: Check a missing save before changing anything
beginners-guide.addition:
1. Confirm the host. Keep the original browser/profile open. A separately hosted game or offline port can use a different save environment.
  2. Confirm the trainer. Use Enter for the named account you already own. For a Guest, inspect Save to account from the existing session before changing browsers.
  3. Name the missing part. League collection, Lab upgrades, a completed result and an unfinished run require separate checks.
  4. Check the save response. Wait for the current game’s success notice and confirm the trainer and progress before leaving the original session.

The v0.8.85 notes announce account-backed continuation on another device and autosave recovery. That applies to the original account service; it does not establish transfer to independent offline ports. For an Expedition result stuck “in progress”, v0.9.14 specifically instructs opening the same browser without starting another run so it can retry saving. If it remains missing, record version, mode, time and result for project support.

Need another distribution? The original Apps menu now lists supported releases. See the current app and browser distinction.

sections.release:
Team pause is available from v0.8.77. Press P or use Ask the team to pause. The world stops once everyone accepts. The team has a five-minute pause budget per run and resumes when everyone votes to continue. Opening your menu alone does not establish a team pause.

Upgrade protection uses a reserve: the v0.8.77 notes describe 45 seconds initially, +15 seconds per level up to 90, and gradual refill. Reroll, banish and skip no longer consume it all at once. This replaces the older five-seconds-per-level, ten-second-cap rule.

Version 0.9.13 reports a fix for protection remaining stuck after an Ultimate or level-up. Check the loaded version before treating the symptom as an intended mechanic. Use the actual teammate prompt to revive and keep its readiness message with any report. No shared match, pause timing or revival was tested here.
sections.matchmaking:
Use a registered trainer account for public matchmaking. In Find a match choose mode, team size, map and difficulty, or Any. A friends’ room can use Find teammates. Check every participant’s destination unlocks, readiness and version.

The original v0.8.85 notes replace the old idle-leader timing with 30 seconds to start and add a kick vote. Use the live room message when a leader transfers. The G / L3 signal wheel and current rebindable controls remain separate from pause and upgrade protection.

For a bubble that remains after an Ultimate, check the v0.9.13 correction and the issue-specific report checklist.

steam-deck.heading: Choose the original app or the browser before remapping
steam-deck.addition:
The original project now offers PC apps. Its current Apps text lists Linux, and the v0.8.81 release names Steam Deck support. Open the original Apps menu to inspect the current package and instructions. The browser routes above remain historical community alternatives.

  1. Record whether you launched a browser, the original Linux app or an independent package.
  2. If startup fails, record the app version, system and exact error before applying a community command.
  3. If the menu opens but movement sticks, compare one input scheme at a time: native gamepad or deliberate keyboard/mouse emulation. Keep saved bindings and Steam Input in the report.
  4. Keep the working browser identity until the new route shows the intended original account.

We did not install an AppImage or test a physical Deck. No FPS, battery, universal startup command or browser-to-app transfer result is promised.

how-to-win.heading: Locate the missing Classic completion step
how-to-win.addition:
If the last wave seems finished, identify the actual checkpoint before restarting. Has the guardian been defeated? Has its intended reward been collected? Is the next portal visible, and have you entered it? At the final encounter, wait for the completion/result message. Record which step is absent rather than relying on the timer alone.

This extends the dated Classic objective sequence above. A missing server result is a separate save or connection check; the newer Expedition “in progress” instruction applies to that event, not every unfinished Classic battle.

replacements: +15 armor; every 8 seconds gains shield worth 8% max HP; ×1.25 damage while shielded.
The extra damage does have a low-HP requirement. Choose for the defensive part if you are learning; deliberately taking damage is a separate, untested tradeoff.

In the v0.9.14 runtime, the damage multiplier requires a shield, not low HP. The shell periodically supplies shield based on maximum HP. Read the currently active condition before choosing an upgrade.

starters.heading: Read the condition that changed in Season 3
starters.addition:
This table compares three Kanto starters. The Season 3 notes also introduce a Johto partner choice, so these three are not the entire current starting roster.

Squirtle’s current Torrent Shell differs from the October description. The runtime lists +15 armor, periodic shield equal to 8% maximum HP every eight seconds and ×1.25 damage while shielded. It does not list the old low-HP damage bonus for this passive.

Bulbasaur’s reviewed Synthesis still lists +1.5 regeneration, +25% healing and eligible Grass-hit healing of 0.4% HP, limited to five triggers per second. Charmander’s Sea of Flames lists +10% Fire damage and ×1.4 damage below 40% HP. Choose the mechanic you want to learn and compare results under the same map, difficulty and owned upgrades.

sections.download:
El proyecto original ya ofrece aplicaciones. Abre pokebonk.com y entra en Apps para comprobar plataformas y destino de descarga. El cliente enumera Windows, macOS, Linux y Android; la v0.8.90 anuncia Android y Mac. La antigua referencia a distribución solo en navegador queda como información histórica.

Para iPhone, comprueba la vía de navegador y cualquier opción que indique el original. Android no establece una aplicación nativa de iOS. Un acceso directo del navegador y una adaptación independiente sin conexión pueden usar entornos distintos; conserva tu sesión antes de comprobar el progreso en otro cliente.

La ventana Play de esta guía carga una fuente de terceros con progreso separado. No es una vía para recuperar la cuenta original.

es/mobile.heading: Comprobar joystick, menús y progreso
es/mobile.addition:
La v0.9.10 corrige el joystick de la v0.9.9 que permitía saltar pero no moverse. La v0.9.12 corrige el desplazamiento táctil de los menús. Comprueba versión y controles actuales antes de modificar otra opción.

Si falta progreso, vuelve al host, perfil y entrenador originales. Distingue colección, mejoras y partida pendiente. La instrucción v0.9.14 para una Expedición atascada en curso es volver en el mismo navegador sin iniciar otra partida; no se verificó recuperación.

원작은 이제 Apps 메뉴에서 앱을 제공합니다. 현재 문구에는 Windows, macOS, Linux, Android가 있으며 v0.8.90은 Android와 Mac 앱을 알립니다. 예전의 브라우저 전용 배포 설명보다 현재 원작 메뉴를 확인하세요. Android 배포만으로 iOS 네이티브 앱을 확인할 수는 없습니다.

모바일에서 점프만 되고 이동이 안 된다면 v0.9.9 문제와 v0.9.10 수정 여부를 확인하세요. 메뉴 스크롤은 v0.9.12에서 수정되었다고 안내합니다. 팀 일시정지는 v0.8.77부터 모두 동의하면 작동하며, 개인 메뉴를 여는 것과 구분해야 합니다.

updates.addition:
Original v0.9.14 / mw4qh5au was inspected November 6, 2026. The release history names Android/Mac apps in v0.8.90, account-backed continuation and autosaves in v0.8.85, mobile joystick repair in v0.9.10, menu scrolling repair in v0.9.12 and the stuck co-op bubble correction in v0.9.13.

Version 0.9.14 specifically instructs returning to the same browser without starting another run when a long Expedition stays “in progress”. It also reports iPhone/Safari zone-transition changes and clearer Echoes of Time markers in Ilex Forest. These are release instructions, not measured recovery, FPS or a completed Rift route.

Use current app routes, account checks and team pause and protection. Older Survival schedules, roster totals, item and fusion tables retain their own dated review scopes.
